recognize_zh: 周邊血中散佈中至大型、細胞質淡灰藍色且無顆粒的芽細胞，核圓或不規則、染色質細緻，看不到 Auer 小體；背景可見淚滴狀紅血球，形態上無法判定系別。
features: Medium to large blasts with moderate to scant pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm
Round to irregular nuclei with fine chromatin; nucleoli faintly visible
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules
Occasional teardrop red cells (dacrocytes) in the background
One refractile yellow-brown round body of uncertain nature, likely artifact
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered medium to large blasts with pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm and round to irregular nuclei with fine chromatin. Auer rods are not identified. Background red cells include occasional teardrop forms, and a refractile yellow-brown round body in the upper left is most likely artifact. Findings are consistent with circulating blasts of acute leukemia without morphologic evidence of lineage; in the context of AML with minimal differentiation, lineage must be confirmed by flow cytometry with negative MPO cytochemistry.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts look similar and require flow cytometry showing B- or T-lineage markers for distinction.
Megakaryoblasts often show cytoplasmic blebs and are CD41/CD61 positive, often with marrow fibrosis.
Monoblasts have more abundant cytoplasm and strong nonspecific esterase with CD14/CD64 expression.
